what: Server-side strategy that replaces the oldest tool results with placeholder text once the prompt passes a threshold. Client keeps full history; API edits the prompt before Claude sees it. Defaults: trigger 100,000 input tokens, keep 3 tool uses, clear_at_least unset, exclude_tools unset, clear_tool_inputs false.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Raw API: beta header anthropic-beta: context-management-2025-06-27 plus body context_management.edits with type clear_tool_uses_20250919. Claude Code: sends context_management itself (errors page says gateways must forward the beta header); no user env var or setting found in the mirrored env-vars or settings pages. Agent SDK TS: no contextManagement option in the Options table; only betas (SdkBeta, currently just context-1m-2025-08-07), so clearing needs a custom fetch/proxy or a raw API call.
price_effect: Saves input tokens on every later turn, but clearing changes the prefix so the cache is invalidated and the rewritten prefix is written again (cache write cost). Use clear_at_least so each clear removes enough tokens to pay for the rewrite.
available_now: Beta; documented as available on all supported models including Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5

what: Server-side strategy for thinking blocks in earlier assistant turns. keep = {type:thinking_turns,value:N} or 'all'. Default keep is all prior thinking on Opus 4.5+, Sonnet 4.6+, Haiku 5.5+ (last turn only on older models). On Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 server-side context management never invalidates thinking blocks.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Same beta header context-management-2025-06-27 and body field, strategy type clear_thinking_20251015. Not exposed as a Claude Code env var or SDK option in the mirrored docs.
price_effect: Keeping thinking keeps the cache prefix (cache reads at 0.05x on Opus 5.5, 0.10x on Haiku 5.5 base). Clearing thinking saves context space but invalidates the cache from the clear point.
available_now: Beta; default behaviour is live on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 without any header change

feature: Server-side compaction (on demand and at a token threshold)
what: The API writes a summary of older turns on the server and returns a compaction block that replaces earlier messages. Two modes: on-demand (you send a request, returns a block) and at a token threshold (one trigger parameter on ordinary requests; API drops what came before the block). Options: keep recent turns verbatim, run in background, custom summarization prompt, compact again.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Raw API: beta header compact-2026-09-04 plus top-level compaction parameter (on-demand); see compaction-threshold page for threshold form. SDK TS: tool_runner can send the compaction request via compact_before_next_turn() (per compaction overview). Claude Code: the mirrored docs describe its own auto-compact (env CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT, autoCompactWindow setting); no evidence in the mirror that Claude Code calls the compact-2026-09-04 API.
price_effect: Summary is an extra model call that reads the conversation, so a large compaction is itself a large request. Afterward the prompt is small, so later turns cost less input. Claude Code docs say /clear costs nothing when a fresh start is wanted.
available_now: Beta (compact-2026-09-04); Claude 4.6 and later and listed models; check the Models API for per-model support

feature: Prompt caching TTL: 5 minute vs 1 hour
what: cache_control breakpoints (explicit per block, or top-level automatic caching). Default lifetime 5 minutes, refreshed free on each hit. 1-hour TTL is an option for prompts used less often than every 5 minutes.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Claude Code: env ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=5m|1h (main conversation), CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL (subagents), settings promptCacheTtl and subagentPromptCacheTtl; FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M=1 overrides all. Agent SDK: set the same env vars via options.env. Raw API: cache_control with ttl 1h.
price_effect: 5m write 1.25x base input; 1h write 2x base; cache read 0.1x base (Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 0.05x; Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 0.025x). 1h pays off after two reads; 5m after one.
available_now: Yes, GA on API, Bedrock, Foundry, Vertex, Claude Code

what: Opus 5.5: base input $4, 5m write $5, 1h write $8, cache hit $0.20, output $20. Haiku 5.5 up to 100k prompt tokens: input $0.10, 5m write $0.125, 1h write $0.20, hit $0.01, output $0.50. Haiku 5.5 over 100k prompt tokens: input $0.50, 5m write $0.625, 1h write $1, hit $0.05, output $2.50. Sonnet 5.5: input $2, output $10, cache hit $0.10. Opus 5 and 4.8: input $5, output $25. Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1: input $10, output $50.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Not a toggle. Batch API halves input and output (Opus 5.5 batch $2/$10; Haiku 5.5 batch $0.05/$0.25 up to 100k). Fast mode on Opus 5.5 is $8/$40 per MTok (research preview).
price_effect: Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a request over 100k prompt tokens (cache reads and writes count) costs 5x per token on every line. Opus 5.5 is 20% cheaper than Opus 5 on input and output.
available_now: Yes, current list prices as of the mirror dated Oct 2026

what: 1M-token window is the default (no beta header) for Fable 5.1/5, Mythos 5.1/5, Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 5.5, Sonnet 5, Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 5.5. Up to 128k output per request.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: API: nothing to send. Claude Code: on by default for Opus 4.7+, Sonnet 5+, Haiku 5.5; opus[1m] / sonnet[1m] for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 turns it off; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW sets the compaction point (100000 to 1000000). Agent SDK: betas option only lists context-1m-2025-08-07 (for retired Sonnet 4/4.5), so not needed on 5.x.
price_effect: Standard per-token price across the whole window on all models except Haiku 5.5, where prompts over 100k tokens pay the higher tier (5x). A 900k request costs the same per token as a 9k request on Opus 5.5. Cost comes from using the context, so pair with compaction or clearing.
available_now: Yes, GA on the Claude API and Claude Code for the listed models

what: Mark tools with defer_loading:true and include a tool_search_tool_regex_20251119 or tool_search_tool_bm25_20251119 tool; only names load up front and full schemas load when Claude searches. Anthropic cites about 85 percent less tool-definition context on multi-server setups.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Raw API: add the search tool to tools and set defer_loading:true on the rest (at least one non-deferred). Claude Code: on by default for MCP tools; ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto:N, =false to disable; alwaysLoad per MCP server. Agent SDK: on by default for SDK MCP tools (see agent-sdk tool-search page).
price_effect: Cuts fixed per-request tool-definition tokens, which are re-read every turn. Cache-friendly because the deferred list is stable.
available_now: Yes: all models from Haiku 4.5 up, including Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5; on by default in Claude Code and the SDK

feature: Agent SDK TypeScript options that touch context and cache
what: Options table: betas (SdkBeta, only context-1m-2025-08-07), env (replaces process.env unless you spread it), settings, effort, thinking, extraArgs. AgentDefinition has autoCompactWindow for subagents. Query has getContextUsage() and holdOnCacheImpact on reloadPlugins. No contextManagement or compaction option in the mirrored table.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Pass env: { ...process.env, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H: '1' } or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT; or settings: { autoCompactWindow, promptCacheTtl }. Changelog 0.3.296 is the newest SDK release in the local mirror (repo commit 85d8f8e, Oct 9 2026).
price_effect: env and settings are the only SDK levers for cache TTL and compaction window; there is no SDK switch for tool-result clearing.

feature: Claude Code auto-compact and context-window controls
what: Env vars: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE (trigger %), CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW (100000 to 1000000), DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT, DISABLE_COMPACT, CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS, CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC (drop pre-compaction history from transcripts over 5 MB).
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Set in shell, or via options.env in the Agent SDK, or in settings (autoCompactWindow, autoCompactEnabled). /compact and /clear are the manual levers; /config toggles auto-compact.
price_effect: A lower compaction window compacts earlier, so the prompt stays smaller on every turn at the cost of more summary calls and cache rebuilds. The Claude Code costs page says clearing between tasks saves tokens on every message.
available_now: Yes, shipped in Claude Code (docs dated Oct 2026)

what: Client-side memory tool: the model reads and writes files in a memory directory across sessions, so facts move out of the window and into storage. Anthropic ships helper classes (for example betaMemoryTool in TypeScript) that run the tool loop; the app supplies the storage backend.
how_to_enable_in_claude_code_or_sdk: Raw API: tools entry {type: memory_20250818, name: memory}. Claude Code has its own CLAUDE.md and auto-memory (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS); this is separate from the API memory tool. Agent SDK: not a typed option; use a custom tool or the raw API.
price_effect: Moves durable facts out of the prompt into on-demand reads, so stable prefix stays small. Each read is a tool result that adds tokens to that turn.
